title: Product Sales Velocity
scenario: Calculate the average quantity sold per year for each product, excluding their first year of sales. Return 'product_id' and 'avg_quantity_after_first'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Filter out min(year) per product using a subquery.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, AVG(quantity::NUMERIC) AS avg_quantity_after_first FROM sales s1 WHERE year > (SELECT MIN(year) FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.product_id = s1.product_id) GROUP BY product_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 5, 100), (2, 100, 2009, 10, 100), (3, 100, 2010, 15, 100);
